binding_corrections: Preserve original supplied cobalt jar, proportions, complete original label and wave logo exactly, including THE OCEAN HEALED MY ECZEMA*. Never rebrand jar Afterwell.
Use supplied official Afterwell wordmark recolored blue separately in footer only.
Product-copy facts: sea moss, aloe vera, oats; no steroids; no added fragrance; 4 fl oz; contains oats and patch test first.
Do not add light, non-greasy, fast-absorbing, soothing, moisturizing or sensory-acceptance product claims to these fact-only copy sets.
Generic scratch/heat/damp-skin facts are from the user brief. No invented studies, numeric absorption, timelines, customer proof, three-ingredient-total assertion or product fragrance-free claim.
Source-label wording is a physical packaging exception, not an extra headline healing claim.
No viewer-condition callout, prescription schedule, steroid rationing, clinical skin comparison, blood, open wounds or cream on broken skin.
